shellCommands.command: git diff && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -not -path './.git/*' -print | head -100 && cat package.json next.config.* 2>/dev/null

for f in app/*.tsx app/*/page.tsx tsconfig.json .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; echo; head -50 __agent_eval__/run.mjs; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -ril "cacheComponents" . | head -30; echo; find . -iname "*cache-components*" -o -iname "*cacheLife*" -o -iname "*use-cache*" | head

(npx next start -p 3456 >/tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s -b 'draft-title=Hello%20Editor' localhost:3456/preview | grep -o 'Hello Editor' | head -1; curl -s -b 'draft-title=Second' localhost:3456/preview | grep -o 'Second' | head -1; curl -s localhost:3456/news | grep -o 'City council[^<]*'; pkill -f "next start" ; grep -rn "instant\|dynamic =\|revalidate =" app; git status --short
cd /workspace; grep -rn "instant\|dynamic =\|revalidate =" app; git status --short; git diff tsconfig.json
